تصطلقوا (form VIII)
# تَصْطَلِقُوا (taṣṭaliqū) /tasˤ.tˤa.li.quː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِصْطَلَقَ (iṣṭalaqa)
# تُصْطَلَقُوا (tuṣṭalaqū) /tusˤ.tˤa.la.quː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِصْطَلَقَ (iṣṭalaqa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
